subject: Request: 24h safety headroom for throughput validation - EdgeCart POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecart.co>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Load validation request: 24h soak/throughput validation (EdgeCart POC)

Hi Jonas,

Quick note following up from our demo last week — the engineering team wants to run a 24-hour throughput/latency soak to validate the checkout model under realistic peak patterns. The goal is a continuous 1,200–1,500 qps sustained window with spike tests up to 2,200 qps for short bursts. Important success criteria are P95 latency < 250ms and no error-rate rise above 0.5%.

Can Redwood provide an ephemeral capacity/credit uplift for a 24-hour window (target start: Fri 11/13 00:00 PT) so we can hit these numbers without throttling? We attached our load plan and traffic profile. If you need further detail on traffic shaping or auth, ping me.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Engineering, EdgeCart
liam@edgecart.co

Attachment: edgecart-load-plan.pdf (application/pdf)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:22 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Load validation request: 24h soak/throughput validation (EdgeCart POC)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Liam's ask. TL;DR: EdgeCart needs an extra 24h safety headroom for a weekend soak starting Fri 11/13 00:00 PT. They want sustained 1.2–1.5k qps with bursts to 2.2k. They're running on our standard hosted endpoint using the rwd-13b-v1 quantized variant.

Proposed internal plan: grant an ephemeral credit uplift equivalent to ~48k token-units (roughly 24h headroom projected from their profile) and enable a temporary higher concurrency slot on the serving pool. Sales-side promo: 40% of the uplift on a trial basis (so net charge reduced) — pending quick finance approval.

Questions for Karthik: can infra reserve the concurrency burst and ensure no noisy neighbor impact in that window? Feel free to adjust numbers if you'd prefer a larger buffer.

-Marshall (on behalf of Jonas)
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:27:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Load validation request: 24h soak/throughput validation (EdgeCart POC)

Jonas / Marissa — I reviewed the attached traffic profile. A few technical notes:

- rwd-13b-v1 quantized should be fine for p95 under those QPS numbers as long as we pin to a dedicated serving shard for the 24h window and avoid cross-tenant autoscale thundering.
- To hit 1.5k sustained qps with <250ms p95 we should provision an extra 3 GPU slots (a temporary Dedicated-like slot) for the time window; with prefix cache warmups, 48k token-equivalent seems conservative but safe.
- We need to lock in the start time (Fri 11/13 00:00 PT) and confirm the traffic profile accuracy (they included short bursts pattern; we'll need to know burst cadence).

If sales signs off on the credit amount, I'll schedule the reserve and add a routing policy to isolate their requests during the window. Infra can stand this up by Thursday EOD if approved today.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:01:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Load validation request: 24h soak/throughput validation (EdgeCart POC)

Thanks for the technical review. Sales is comfortable with the uplift but we need quick approval on the promotional offset (the 40% trial credit on the uplift). I'm attaching a short promo approval note that I can sign off on for this POC if Finance concurs — it outlines the reasoning (strategic account, likely expansion in Q1) and the net expected ARR impact.

If Finance gives the green light, we can commit to the 48k-equivalent uplift with a 24h reserved slot and a clear rollback plan in case of unexpected issues. Karthik, please proceed to schedule once we confirm.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: promo-approval-note.txt (text/plain)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgecart.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 22:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Load validation request: 24h soak/throughput validation (EdgeCart POC)

Liam — good news: we can support the 24-hour soak you described. Summary of what we approved:

- Ephemeral uplift: equivalent to 48,000 token-units for a 24-hour window; start Fri 11/13 00:00 PT, end Sat 11/14 00:00 PT.
- Promo: Redwood will apply a 40% trial credit on the uplift for this POC (sales-approved, promo note attached to internal folder).
- Technical guarantees: Karthik has reserved an isolated serving shard and will apply routing isolation and cache priming. Our runtime team will monitor p95 and error rate and will throttle only if error-rate > 1% to preserve cluster health.

Next steps for EdgeCart: please confirm final start time and provide a short preflight test window on Thursday (we propose Thu 11/12 20:00–21:00 PT) so we can validate warm caches and auth. Also confirm contact for on-call during the soak (name + phone/email).

I'll drop the official uplift and promo details into your HubSpot record and the shared drive. Thanks — excited to get this validated.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0183
